user.title: Garmin watch over BLE
user.description: Home Assistant will advertise a Bluetooth service on this adapter. Entities carrying the label below are exposed to the watch.

data.label: Label of exposed entities
data.secret: Shared secret (32 hex digits, leave empty to generate)

secret.title: Copy this secret to the watch
secret.description:
Enter this value as "Shared secret" in the HassControl BLE app settings (Garmin Connect app > Connect IQ > HassControl BLE > Settings):

`{secret}`

It stays stored in this integration's configuration.

error.bad_secret: The secret must be exactly 32 hexadecimal digits.
